title: thymus serpyllum var. austriacus
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. austriacus, commonly known as Austrian wild thyme, is a plant species within the thyme family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including antimicrobial and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Austrian wild thyme include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly thymol and carvacrol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
